name: Mercedes-Benz Group
notes: DaimlerChrysler AG (to 2007) -> Daimler AG (2007-2022) -> Mercedes-Benz Group AG. revenue = 'Revenue(s)'; operatingIncome = Group 'Operating profit' (US GAAP segment measure, 2000-2004) / 'EBIT' (IFRS, 2005+), as presented in the company's own Ten Year Summaries (reported, not adjusted EBIT). PERIMETER BREAKS: 2000-2004 US GAAP incl. Chrysler; 2005 onward IFRS excl. Chrysler (Chrysler shown as discontinued after 2007 deconsolidation; Daimler's ten-year summary restates 2005-2006 accordingly), hence the ~EUR 47bn revenue drop between 2004 and 2005. 2000-2001 from FY2002 20-F (pre later discontinued-ops restatements; 2002 there was 149,583/6,854 vs 147,408/6,827 restated). 2000 incl. restructuring; 2001 operating loss incl. Chrysler restructuring. 2002-2004 from the Ten Year Summary (US GAAP). Through 2020 includes Daimler Trucks & Buses; 2021 onward continuing operations only (Daimler Truck spun off Dec 2021; 2021 incl. DT would be 167,971/29,069 incl. deconsolidation effects). 2008/2007 revenue restated per IAS 16 amendment (+2,596/+2,170). Source hosting: 2011 and 2020 annual reports are company PDFs mirrored at ddd.uab.cat, 2021 at Bucharest Stock Exchange (bvb.ro), 2023 at EQS (company IR host); group.mercedes-benz.com returned 403. 2024-2025 from the FY2025 results press release on media.mercedes-benz.com (FY2025 annual report PDF too large to fetch).
